english.note: This is the all-purpose Cantonese noun for a building used to grow plants under controlled warmth.
Use this as the all-purpose word for a glass building where delicate plants are cultivated.

examples.english: This greenhouse can grow vegetables even in winter.
examples.traditional: 呢間溫室冬天都可以種菜。
examples.jyutping: nei1 gaan1 wan1 sat1 dung1 tin1 dou1 ho2 ji5 zung3 coi3

examples.english: There are lots of orchids in this conservatory.
examples.traditional: 呢間溫室入面種咗好多蘭花。
examples.jyutping: ni1 gaan1 wan1 sat1 jap6 min6 zung3 zo2 hou2 do1 laan4 faa1
